title: Output Vector Editing for Memorization Mitigation in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.18767v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models can reproduce training text, creating privacy, copyright, and security risks. We propose Output Vector Editing (OVE), a post-hoc method for suppressing text continuations that a model reproduces from a given prefix. Under superposition, a neuron can contribute to multiple features. Yet some neuron-level mitigation methods suppress localized neurons by zeroing their activations, removing each neuron's entire contribution. OVE instead edits their output vectors, combining (i) two-stage localization of MLP layers and neurons with (ii) full-vocabulary least-squares updates. Its multi-anchor variant, OVE-MA, adaptively selects continuation positions expected to provide stronger suppression relative to the required weight change. We evaluate recovery and locality across four models (360M--7B parameters), using autoregressively validated continuations and recovery tests with greedy decoding, beam search, and sampling.

translated_title: 面向大语言模型记忆化缓解的输出向量编辑
translated_abstract: 大语言模型可能会复现训练文本，从而带来隐私、版权和安全风险。我们提出了输出向量编辑（OVE），这是一种事后处理方法，用于抑制模型从给定前缀复现出的文本延续内容。在叠加假设下，一个神经元可能对多个特征都有贡献，然而一些神经元层面的缓解方法通过将定位到的神经元激活置零来进行抑制，这会移除每个神经元的全部贡献。OVE 则改为编辑神经元的输出向量，该方法结合了两个阶段的 MLP 层与神经元定位，以及全词表最小二乘更新。其多锚点变体 OVE-MA 能够自适应地选择那些相对于所需权重变化而言预期可提供更强抑制效果的延续位置。我们在四个模型（参数量从 3.6 亿到 70 亿）上评估了恢复性与局部性，使用了经自回归验证的延续内容，并采用贪心解码、束搜索和采样进行恢复测试。
tldr: 提出输出向量编辑（OVE）方法，通过两阶段定位神经元并用全词表最小二乘更新编辑其输出向量（而非将激活置零），有效抑制大语言模型复现记忆的训练文本，同时更好地保留模型其他能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes Output Vector Editing (OVE), which mitigates memorization in large language models by two-stage neuron localization and full-vocabulary least-squares edits to neuron output vectors, suppressing reproduction of memorized text while better preserving overall model behavior.
